title: The Balance Between Overfitting and Underfitting and How to Deal With Each

cues.en: In the last video, we looked at our models, loss curves and also the accuracy curves.
cues.zh: 上支影片看了模型的損失曲線，也看了準確率曲線。

cues.en: And a loss curve is a way to evaluate a model's performance over time, such as how long it was training for.
cues.zh: 損失曲線是一種隨時間評估模型表現的方法，例如隨訓練時間的變化。

cues.en: And as you'll see, if you Google some images of lost curves, you'll see many different types of loss curves.
cues.zh: 用 Google 搜尋損失曲線圖片，就會看到許多不同類型。

cues.en: They come in all different shapes and sizes, and there's many different ways to interpret loss curves.
cues.zh: 形狀各式各樣，解讀方式也有很多種。

cues.en: So this is Google's testing and debugging and machine learning guide.
cues.zh: 這是 Google 的機器學習測試與除錯指南。

cues.en: So I'm going to set this as actually curriculum for this section.
cues.zh: 把它當作本節延伸學習。

cues.en: So we're up to number eight.
cues.zh: 現在到第 8 節。

cues.en: Let's have a look at what should an ideal loss curve look like.
cues.zh: 看看理想的損失曲線應該是什麼樣子。

cues.en: So we'll just link that in there.
cues.zh: 把連結放進來。

cues.en: Now, Lost Curve.
cues.zh: 現在，損失曲線。

cues.en: I'll just rewrite.
cues.zh: 我重新寫一下。

cues.en: Here is a lost curve is.
cues.zh: 這裡，損失曲線是，

cues.en: Polish maximum space.
cues.zh: 多留一點空間。

cues.en: I Lost Curve is one of the most helpful ways to troubleshoot a model.
cues.zh: 損失曲線，是排除模型問題最有幫助的方法之一。

cues.en: So the trend of a lost curve, you want it to go down over time and the trend typically of an evaluation metric like accuracy, you want it to go up over time.
cues.zh: 損失曲線希望隨時間下降；準確率這類評估指標，通常希望隨時間上升。

cues.en: So let's go into the keynote loss curves.
cues.zh: 回到簡報，損失曲線。

cues.en: So a way to evaluate your model's performance over time.
cues.zh: 一種隨時間評估模型表現的方法。

cues.en: These are three of the main different forms of loss curve that you'll face.
cues.zh: 這是最主要、會遇到的三種損失曲線。

cues.en: But again, there's many different types, as mentioned in here, interpreting loss curves.
cues.zh: 不過，如這裡 Interpreting Loss Curves 提到的，還有很多種類。

cues.en: Sometimes you get it going all over the place.
cues.zh: 有時曲線到處亂跑。

cues.en: Sometimes your loss will explode, sometimes your metrics will be contradictory.
cues.zh: 有時損失會爆增，有時指標會互相矛盾。

cues.en: Sometimes you're testing loss will be higher than your training loss.
cues.zh: 有時測試損失會高於訓練損失。

cues.en: We'll have a look at what that is.
cues.zh: 等一下看看這代表什麼。

cues.en: Sometimes your model gets stuck.
cues.zh: 有時模型會卡住。

cues.en: In other words, the loss doesn't reduce.
cues.zh: 換句話說，損失不再下降。

cues.en: Let's have a look at some loss curves here in the case of unbefitting overfitting and just right.
cues.zh: 來看欠擬合、過擬合，以及剛剛好的損失曲線。

cues.en: So this is the Goldilocks zone Under fitting is when your model's loss on the training and test data sets could be lower.
cues.zh: 這就是恰到好處的區域；欠擬合，指模型在訓練與測試資料集的損失還能更低。

cues.en: So in our case, if we go back to our loss curves, of course we want this to be lower and we want our accuracy to be higher.
cues.zh: 以我們為例，回到損失曲線，當然希望它更低，準確率更高。

cues.en: So from our perspective, it looks like our model is under fitting and we would probably want to train it for longer, say 10 to 20 epochs to see if this trend continues.
cues.zh: 從我們的角度，看來模型欠擬合，可能要再訓練久一點，比如 10 到 20 個週期，看看趨勢能否持續。

cues.en: If it keeps going down, it may stop under fitting.
cues.zh: 如果持續下降，可能就不再欠擬合。

cues.en: So under fitting is when your loss could be lower.
cues.zh: 所以，欠擬合就是損失還能更低。

cues.en: Now their inverse of unbefitting is called overfitting.
cues.zh: 欠擬合的相反，叫作過擬合。

cues.en: And so two of the biggest problems in machine learning is trying to reduce unbefitting.
cues.zh: 機器學習最大的兩個問題之一，就是試著減少欠擬合，

cues.en: So in other words, make your loss lower and also reduce overfitting.
cues.zh: 換句話說，讓損失更低，同時也減少過擬合。

cues.en: These are both active areas of research because you always want your model to perform better, but you also want it to perform pretty much the same on the training set as it does the test set.
cues.zh: 兩者都是活躍的研究領域，因為總希望模型表現更好，也希望訓練集與測試集表現差不多。

cues.en: And so overfitting would be when your training loss is lower than your testing loss.
cues.zh: 過擬合，就是訓練損失低於測試損失。

cues.en: And why would this be overfitting?
cues.zh: 為什麼這是過擬合？

cues.en: So it means overfitting because your model is essentially learning the training data too well, and that means the loss goes down on the training data set, which is typically a good thing.
cues.zh: 因為模型基本上把訓練資料學得太好了，所以訓練資料集損失下降，通常這是好事。

cues.en: However, this learning is not reflected in the testing data set.
cues.zh: 但這種學習成果，沒有反映在測試資料集。

cues.en: So your model is essentially memorizing patterns in the training data set that don't generalize well to the test data set.
cues.zh: 模型基本上記住訓練資料集的模式，卻無法好好泛化到測試資料集。

cues.en: So this is where we come to the just right curve is that we want ideally our training loss to reduce as much as our test loss.
cues.zh: 所以才希望到達剛剛好的曲線：理想上，訓練損失能像測試損失一樣下降。

cues.en: And quite often you'll find that the loss is slightly lower on the training set than it is on the test set.
cues.zh: 通常會發現，訓練集損失略低於測試集。

cues.en: And that's just because the model is exposed to the training data and it's never seen the test data before.
cues.zh: 因為模型接觸過訓練資料，卻從未見過測試資料。

cues.en: So it might be a little bit lower on the training data set than on the test data set.
cues.zh: 所以訓練資料集損失可能會比測試資料集稍低。

cues.en: So under fitting the models loss could be lower overfitting.
cues.zh: 欠擬合，是模型損失還能更低；過擬合，

cues.en: The model is learning the training data too well.
cues.zh: 是模型把訓練資料學得太好。

cues.en: Now, this would be equivalent to say you were studying for a final exam and you just memorize the course materials, the training said.
cues.zh: 這就好比準備期末考，卻只是背下課程教材，也就是訓練集。

cues.en: And when it came time to the final exam, because you don't even memorize the course materials, you couldn't adapt those skills to questions you hadn't seen before.
cues.zh: 等到期末考，因為只背教材，就無法把技能應用到沒見過的題目。

cues.en: So the final exam would be the test set.
cues.zh: 期末考就是測試集。

cues.en: So that's overfitting.
cues.zh: 這就是過擬合。

cues.en: The train loss is lower than the test loss.
cues.zh: 訓練損失低於測試損失。

cues.en: And just right, ideally you probably won't see loss curves this exact smooth.
cues.zh: 至於剛剛好，理想上……你可能不會看到這麼平滑的損失曲線。

cues.en: I mean, there might be a little bit jumpy.
cues.zh: 可能會有點跳動。

cues.en: Ideally, your training loss and test loss go down at a similar rate.
cues.zh: 理想上，訓練損失與測試損失以類似速度下降。

cues.en: And of course there's more combinations of these if you'd like to see them, check out the Google's loss curve guide that you can check that out up there.
cues.zh: 當然還有更多組合，想看的話，可以查 Google 的損失曲線指南，上面有連結。

cues.en: That's some extra curriculum.
cues.zh: 這是延伸學習。

cues.en: Now, you probably want to know how do you deal with unbefitting and overfitting?
cues.zh: 現在你大概想知道，怎麼處理欠擬合與過擬合？

cues.en: Let's look at a few ways.
cues.zh: 看幾種方法。

cues.en: We'll start with overfitting.
cues.zh: 先從過擬合開始。

cues.en: So we want to reduce overfitting.
cues.zh: 要減少過擬合。

cues.en: In other words, we want our model to perform just as well on the training data set as it does on the test data set.
cues.zh: 換句話說，希望模型在訓練資料集與測試資料集的表現一樣好。

cues.en: So one of the best ways to reduce overfitting is to get more data.
cues.zh: 減少過擬合最好的方法之一，是取得更多資料。

cues.en: So this means that our training data set will be larger.
cues.zh: 這表示訓練資料集會更大。

cues.en: Our model will be exposed to more examples and will thus, in theory, it doesn't always work.
cues.zh: 模型能接觸更多範例，因此理論上，不過不一定總有效。

cues.en: These all come with a caveat, right?
cues.zh: 這些都附帶前提，對吧？

cues.en: They don't always work, as with many things in machine learning.
cues.zh: 不一定每次都有效，和機器學習很多事情一樣。

cues.en: So get more data.
cues.zh: 所以，取得更多資料。

cues.en: Give your model more chance to learn patterns, generalizable patterns in a data set.
cues.zh: 給模型更多機會，學習資料集裡能泛化的模式。

cues.en: You can use data augmentation, so make your models training data set harder to learn.
cues.zh: 可以用資料增強，讓訓練資料集更難學習。

cues.en: So we've seen a few examples of data augmentation.
cues.zh: 已經看過幾個資料增強範例。

cues.en: You can get better data, So not only more data, perhaps the data that you're using isn't that the quality, isn't that good.
cues.zh: 可以取得更好的資料；不只是更多，也許目前資料品質不太好。

cues.en: So if you enhance the quality of your data set, your model may be able to learn better, more generalizable patterns and in turn reduce overfitting.
cues.zh: 提升資料集品質，模型可能學到更好、泛化能力更強的模式，進而減少過擬合。

cues.en: Use transfer learning.
cues.zh: 使用遷移學習。

cues.en: So we're going to cover this in a later section of the course.
cues.zh: 課程後面的章節會介紹。

cues.en: But transfer learning is taking one models that works, taking its patterns that it's learned and applying it to your own data set.
cues.zh: 遷移學習，是取用一個有效模型學到的模式，套用到自己的資料集。

cues.en: So, for example, I'll just go into the Torch Vision Models library.
cues.zh: 例如，到 torchvision.models 函式庫。

cues.en: Many of these models in here in Torch Vision, the models module, have already been trained on a certain
cues.zh: torchvision 的 models 模組裡，很多模型已經在某個

cues.en: data set and such as image net, and you can take the weights or the patterns that these models have learned.
cues.zh: 資料集，例如 ImageNet 訓練過，可以取用它們學到的權重或模式。

cues.en: And if they work well on an image net data set, which is millions of different images, you can adjust those patterns to your own problem.
cues.zh: 如果它們在包含數百萬張不同影像的 ImageNet 表現很好，就能把這些模式調整到自己的問題。

cues.en: And oftentimes that will help with overfitting.
cues.zh: 通常對過擬合有幫助。

cues.en: If you're still overfitting, you can try to simplify your model.
cues.zh: 如果仍然過擬合，可以試著簡化模型。

cues.en: Usually this means taking away things like extra layers, taking away more hidden units.
cues.zh: 通常就是拿掉額外的層，減少隱藏單元。

cues.en: So say you had ten layers, you might reduce it to five layers.
cues.zh: 比如原本 10 層，可以減成 5 層。

cues.en: Why does this?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: What's the theory behind this?
cues.zh: 背後理論是什麼？

cues.en: Well, if you simplify your model and take away complexity from your model, you're kind of telling your model, hey, use what you've got and you're going to have to because you've only got five layers
cues.zh: 簡化模型、減少複雜度，就像告訴模型：「用你手上的資源，而且必須如此，因為現在只有 5

cues.en: now.
cues.zh: 層了。」

cues.en: You're going to have to make sure that those five layers work really well because you've no longer got ten and the same four hidden units.
cues.zh: 「必須讓這 5 層發揮得很好，因為已經沒有 10 層。」隱藏單元也是一樣。

cues.en: So you started with 100 hidden units per layer.
cues.zh: 如果每層原本有 100 個隱藏單元，

cues.en: You might reduce that to 50 and say, Hey, you had 100 before, now use those 50 and make your patterns generalizable.
cues.zh: 可以減為 50，告訴它：「原本有 100，現在善用這 50 個，學出能泛化的模式。」

cues.en: Use learning rate decay.
cues.zh: 使用學習率衰減。

cues.en: So the learning rate is how much your optimizer updates.
cues.zh: 學習率表示最佳化器更新的幅度，

cues.en: It's all your optimizer updates, your models weights every step.
cues.zh: 就是每一步更新模型權重的幅度。

cues.en: So learning rate decay is to decay the learning rate over time.
cues.zh: 學習率衰減，就是讓學習率隨時間降低。

cues.en: So you might look this up you can look this up go PyTorch learning rate.
cues.zh: 可以查查，搜尋 PyTorch learning rate

cues.en: Scheduling.
cues.zh: scheduling。

cues.en: So what this means is you want to decrease your learning rate over time.
cues.zh: 意思是隨時間降低學習率。

cues.en: Now, I know I'm giving you a lot of different things here, but you've got this keynote as a reference so you can come across these over time.
cues.zh: 我知道這裡給了很多不同方法，但你有簡報能參考，可以隨時間慢慢認識。

cues.en: So learning rate scheduling.
cues.zh: 學習率排程。

cues.en: So we might look into here.
cues.zh: 可以看看這裡。

cues.en: Do we have schedule scheduler?
cues.zh: 有 schedule、scheduler 嗎？

cues.en: Beautiful.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So this is going to adjust the learning rate over time.
cues.zh: 這會隨時間調整學習率。

cues.en: So for example, at the start of when a model is training, you might want a higher learning rate.
cues.zh: 例如模型剛開始訓練，可能想用較高學習率。

cues.en: And then as the model starts to learn patterns more and more and more, you might want to reduce that learning rate over time so that your model doesn't update its patterns too much in later epochs.
cues.zh: 等模型學到越來越多模式，可能想逐步降低學習率，避免後面的週期更新模式太多。

cues.en: So that's a concept of learning rate scheduling.
cues.zh: 這就是學習率排程的概念。

cues.en: The closer you get to convergence, the lower you might want to set your learning rate.
cues.zh: 越接近收斂，可能越想把學習率設低。

cues.en: Think of it like this If you're reaching for a coin at the back of a couch, can we get an image of that coin at back of couch?
cues.zh: 想像一下，伸手拿沙發後面的硬幣；能找到這種圖片嗎？coin at back of couch。

cues.en: Images.
cues.zh: 圖片。

cues.en: So if you're trying to reach a coin in the cushions here.
cues.zh: 如果正試著拿出這裡靠墊裡的硬幣，

cues.en: So the closer you get to that coin at the beginning, you might take big steps.
cues.zh: 一開始可能動作比較大。

cues.en: But then the closer you get to that coin, the smaller the step you might take to pick that coin out.
cues.zh: 但越接近硬幣，就可能越小幅移動，去把它拿出來。

cues.en: Because if you take a big step when you're really close to the coin here, the coin might fall down the couch.
cues.zh: 因為已經很靠近時，如果動作太大，硬幣可能掉進沙發。

cues.en: The same thing with learning right decay at the start of your model training, you might take bigger steps as your model works its way down the loss curve, but then you get closer and closer to the ideal
cues.zh: 學習率衰減也是一樣，模型剛開始訓練可以跨大步，沿損失曲線前進；但越接近曲線上的理想

cues.en: position on the loss curve.
cues.zh: 位置，

cues.en: You might start to lower and lower that learning rate until you get right very close to the end and you can pick up the coin.
cues.zh: 就可能逐漸降低學習率，直到非常靠近終點，拿起硬幣。

cues.en: Or in other words, your model can converge and then finally use early stopping.
cues.zh: 換句話說，模型能收斂；最後，使用提早停止。

cues.en: So if we go into an image, does that is that early stopping here?
cues.zh: 搜尋圖片，這裡有提早停止嗎？

cues.en: Early stopping.
cues.zh: Early stopping。

cues.en: Loss curve's early stopping.
cues.zh: Loss curves early stopping。

cues.en: So what this means is that you stop.
cues.zh: 意思是停止。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 有了。

cues.en: So there's heaps of different guides early stopping with PyTorch.
cues.zh: 有很多不同指南，PyTorch 的提早停止。

cues.en: Beautiful.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So what this means is, before your testing error starts to go up, you keep track of your model's testing error, and then you stop your model from training, or you save the weights or you save the patterns
cues.zh: 意思是在測試誤差開始上升前，追蹤模型測試誤差，停止訓練，或儲存權重、儲存模式，

cues.en: where your model's loss was the lowest.
cues.zh: 選擇模型損失最低的地方。

cues.en: So then you could just set your model to train for an infinite amount of training steps.
cues.zh: 所以能設定模型訓練無限多步。

cues.en: And as soon as the testing error starts to increase for, say, ten steps in a row, you go back to this point here and you go, I think that was where our model was the best and the testing error started
cues.zh: 一旦測試誤差連續，比如 10 步都增加，就回到這個位置，說：「我想這是模型表現最好的地方，測試誤差在這之後

cues.en: to increase after that.
cues.zh: 開始增加。」

cues.en: So we're going to save that model there instead of the model here.
cues.zh: 所以儲存那裡的模型，而非這裡的模型。

cues.en: So that's the concept of early stopping.
cues.zh: 這就是提早停止的概念。

cues.en: So that's dealing with overfitting.
cues.zh: 以上是處理過擬合。

cues.en: There are other methods to deal with under fitting.
cues.zh: 也有其他方法處理欠擬合。

cues.en: So recall unbefitting is when we have a loss that isn't as low as we'd like it to be.
cues.zh: 記得，欠擬合，是損失還沒低到想要的程度。

cues.en: Our model is not fitting the data very well, so it's under fitting.
cues.zh: 模型沒有很好地擬合資料，所以叫欠擬合。

cues.en: So to reduce, under fitting you can add more layers slash units to your model.
cues.zh: 要減少欠擬合，可以增加模型的層數或單元數。

cues.en: You're trying to increase your model's ability to learn by adding more layers or units.
cues.zh: 透過增加層數或單元數，提升模型學習能力。

cues.en: You can again tweak the learning rate.
cues.zh: 同樣能調整學習率。

cues.en: Perhaps your learning rate is too high to begin with and your model doesn't learn very well, So you can adjust the learning rate again, just like we discussed with reaching for that coin at the back of account.
cues.zh: 或許學習率一開始太高，模型學不好，所以能再調整，就像剛才談伸手拿沙發後面的硬幣。

cues.en: If your model is still under fitting, you can train for longer.
cues.zh: 如果仍然欠擬合，就訓練更久。

cues.en: So that means giving your model more opportunities to look at the data.
cues.zh: 讓模型有更多機會看資料。

cues.en: So more epochs, that just means it's got looking at the training set over and over and over and over again and trying to learn those patterns.
cues.zh: 更多訓練週期，表示反覆、反覆查看訓練集，試著學到模式。
